verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Martin publishes an llms.txt at docs.trymartin.com (HTTP 200) that indexes its docs as Markdown links. The docs themselves are served as .md pages, so an agent can consume them directly. The .md.md 404 is just the probe doubling an already-.md path, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: an llms-full.txt or explicit agent-oriented guidance, and independent or hands-on confirmation of agents using these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
